title: A structural closure of growth-sector couplings between discrete gravity and cosmology
description: Tests three operator-level ways Energy-Flow Cosmology could couple to the linear growth equation: multiplicative Geff in the Poisson term, additive local friction, and additive non-local (memory) friction. Using DESI DR2 BAO, cosmic-chronometer H(z), fσ8, and EG data, it shows each class is either structurally excluded or degenerate with Ωm once geometry is locked, implying growth-only observables cannot discriminate this theory class and pointing to lensing/slip or cross-correlations as the next informative directions.
author: Morten Magnusson

eq1_growth_LCDM.description: Linear growth equation for matter overdensity in flat ΛCDM, with E(a)=H(a)/H0 and primes denoting d/da.

eq2_Geff.latex: \frac{G_{\rm eff}(k,a)}{G} = 1 + \big(C^2 - 1\big)\, g(a)\, s(k), \quad g(a) = \frac{1}{1+e^{-(a-a_t)/\delta a}}, \quad s(k) = \frac{1}{1+(k/k_\Lambda)^2}
eq2_Geff.description: Class A coupling: multiplicative modification of the Poisson source via a gated, low-pass-screened effective Newton's constant.

eq3_local_friction.description: Class B coupling: additive, gate-activated local friction β g(a)/a on the velocity term; source term unchanged.

eq4_memory_kernel.latex: G(a) = \int_0^a g(a')\,da' = \delta a\,\ln\!\big(1 + e^{(a-a_t)/\delta a}\big) - \ln\!\big(1 + e^{-a_t/\delta a}\big)
eq4_memory_kernel.description: Class C coupling: time-accumulated gate (memory kernel) producing non-local friction β G(a)/a that breaks Markovian evolution.

eq5_background.description: Flat ΛCDM background expansion used in all classes for the structural test.

eq6_EG_statistic.description: Quasi-static EG statistic; for growth-only modifications with \Sigma=1 it reduces to \Omega_{m,0}/f(z), containing no information independent of fσ8 once \Omega_{m,0} is fixed.

key_results.main_finding: All three tested coupling classes (multiplicative Geff, local friction, non-local memory friction) are either structurally excluded by the data or absorbed by the Ωm–coupling degeneracy once geometry is locked by BAO+H(z); EG with Σ=1 adds no information beyond fσ8.
parameters_tested: Σ (lensing response; fixed to 1 in growth-only tests)
datasets_used: DESI DR2 BAO (DM/rd and DH/rd with full covariance)
fσ8 compilation: 6dFGS, SDSS MGS, BOSS DR12 (3×3 covariance), VIPERS, FastSound
EG measurements: Amon et al., Reyes et al., Singh et al., Blake et al., de la Torre et al.
Sound horizon rd fixed to Planck 2018

sealed_predictions.statement: In the quasi-static regime with Σ=1 and geometry anchored by BAO+H(z), EG(z) provides no independent constraining power beyond fσ8(z) because EG = Ωm,0 / f(z).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: A joint analysis showing that adding EG data shifts or tightens growth constraints relative to fσ8-only beyond what is implied by the Ωm prior from BAO+H(z).

sealed_predictions.statement: Any apparent preference for a non-zero local friction β from fσ8-only fits will disappear when imposing the BAO-anchored Ωm prior.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: A BAO+H(z)-anchored growth analysis that still finds β ≠ 0 at ≥3σ, robust to survey covariances and σ8/H0 priors.

kill_criteria: KC1: Demonstrate that, with Σ=1 and Ωm fixed by BAO+H(z), adding EG measurements leads to a statistically significant (e.g., >3σ) improvement in growth constraints beyond fσ8-only expectations, contradicting EG = Ωm,0/f(z).
KC2: Find a robust (≥3σ) non-zero best-fit β in Class B (local friction) that persists under a BAO+H(z)-anchored Ωm prior and full growth-data covariances.
KC3: Show that Class C (non-local memory friction) yields a stable preference (e.g., Δχ² ≤ −9 for one extra parameter) without degrading BAO/H(z) fits, after marginalizing over Ωm, σ8, and H0.

KC4: Establish that a multiplicative Geff with C ≈ 2.32 and a physically reasonable k_Λ fits the joint growth dataset while remaining consistent with BAO+H(z), contradicting the paper’s structural exclusion of this class under fixed background.

KC5: Provide a data-driven counterexample where growth-only observables, with geometry locked, distinguish between at least two operator classes at ≥3σ, refuting the paper’s claim that growth alone is insufficient.

related_packages.role: Code and data pipelines for growth-sector coupling tests (pipelines/efc/grav_bridge/)
